stations.title: Wilf
stations.say: Can the board read my plan?

captions: In the depot, Wilf wants the ride board to show the plan he writes each morning.
His plan says the Foundry Belle, but the board still shows yesterday's tram.
You swap every typed value on the board for one read from today.js, in five tasks.
The board shows today's tram, its times, its fares, its photo and its colour.
Same board, but now it follows Wilf's plan. Nobody retypes it in the morning.
